title: DeLonge's advisers went quiet when asked about hybrids

tellings.quote: So De Long, when he came out, he was like, there's a big genetic component to this. And he said, I you know, I asked my advisors these questions, these questions, but the moment I asked them about hybrids, they were like, went quiet.

plain: Around 2016 and 2017, Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who went public with UFO claims, said there was 'a big genetic component' to the phenomenon, and that his advisers answered his questions until he asked about hybrids of humans and aliens, at which point 'they went quiet'. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this as what DeLonge said, taking the silence to mean the hybrid question touches something hidden.
